# Visible Body

> > Visible Body provides interactive 3D anatomy and biology visualization software for students, educators, and healthcare professionals to explore the human body through virtual dissection and immersive learning.

Visible Body offers a comprehensive suite of 3D anatomy and physiology learning tools including interactive courseware, mobile AR applications, and institutional licenses for schools, universities, and libraries. The platform serves over 1,000 institutions globally with customizable content for K-12 through professional medical education.

## Key Topics

- 3D Anatomy Visualization
- Visible Body Suite

## Core Products

- [Visible Body - Virtual Anatomy to See Inside the Human Body](https://www.visiblebody.com): Visible Body homepage showcasing 3D anatomy and biology content for students, teachers, and health professionals.
- [Visible Body Suite](https://www.visiblebody.com/anatomy-and-physiology-apps/vb-suite): Visible Body Suite product page with access to interactive anatomy, physiology, and biology content.
- [Visible Body Courseware | Interactive Life Science Learning](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-anatomy/courseware): Visible Body Courseware 3D learning platform with interactive assignments and LMS integration.
- [Visible Body Augmented Reality for iOS and Android](https://www.visiblebody.com/ar): Visible Body AR app for iOS and Android enabling virtual dissection and organ study.
- [Find Your Product](https://www.visiblebody.com/anatomy-and-physiology-apps): Product catalog for browsing Visible Body's anatomy, physiology, pathology, and biology products.

## Institutional & Educational Solutions

- [Visible Body for Institutions](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-anatomy/institutional-licenses): Institutional licensing for schools and libraries with anatomy, physiology, and pathology content.
- [Visible Body for K-12 Schools](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-anatomy/k-12): Visible Body dissection software for K-12 schools with human and animal models.
- [Library Subscription Overview](https://www.visiblebody.com/librarians/overview): Library subscription overview with anatomy, physiology, pathology, and biology content.
- [Visible Body for Students](https://www.visiblebody.com/student-learning): Visible Body Suite and Courseware access guide for students studying anatomy and biology.

## Teaching & Learning Resources

- [How to Teach with Visible Body](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-anatomy): Guide on using Visible Body's interactive 3D models to improve anatomy and biology teaching.
- [How to Teach Biology in 3D](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-biology): Guide for using 3D models and simulations to teach abstract biology topics effectively.
- [Visible Body - Education Resources](https://www.visiblebody.com/education-resources): Complete guide to Visible Body's educational resources library for teaching anatomy.
- [Visible Body Courses](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-anatomy/courses): Prebuilt anatomy courses for instructors to supplement textbooks or replace lab manuals.
- [LMS Integration with Courseware](https://www.visiblebody.com/teaching-anatomy/lms-integration): Guide to LMS integration with Courseware for Blackboard, Canvas, D2L, Moodle, and others.

## Study Tools & Content

- [The Best Life Science Study Tool | Visible Body Flashcards](https://www.visiblebody.com/flashcard-decks): Premade flashcard decks for mastering anatomy, biology, physiology, and pathology courses.
- [Premade 3D Tours | Visible Body](https://www.visiblebody.com/tours): Free premade 3D presentations for Visible Body Suite and Courseware accounts.
- [Visible Body | Videos](https://www.visiblebody.com/videos): Free bite-sized anatomy, physiology, pathology, and biology videos with 3D animations.
